long_name: RM0438 2046/2187 RM0438 Rev 8 DWT cycle count register (DWT_CYCCNTR)
description: RM0438 2046/2187 RM0438 Rev 8 DWT cycle count register specification

bit_fields.name: POSTRESET[3
bit_fields.description: 0]: reload value of the POSTCNT counter

bit_fields.name: POSTINIT[3
bit_fields.description: 0]: initial value of the POSTCNT counter

bit_fields.name: CYCTAP
bit_fields.description: Selects the position of the POSTCNT tap on the CYCCNT counter.

bit_fields.name: SYNCTAP[1
bit_fields.description: 0]: position of the synchronization packet counter tap on the CYCCNT counter

bit_fields.name: PCSAMPLENA
bit_fields.description: enable for POSTCNT counter to be used as a timer for periodic PC sample

bit_fields.name: CPIEVTENA
bit_fields.description: enable for CPI counter overflow event generation

bit_fields.name: EXCEVTENA
bit_fields.description: enable for exception overhead counter overflow event generation

bit_fields.name: SLEEPEVTENA
bit_fields.description: enable for sleep counter overflow event generation
